resources.string: Shizuku lets Tandem do a few things an app may not do by itself. It is optional: without it everything still works, with a tap or a question more.
Tap to open Shizuku and start it. It stops when the phone restarts
Running, Tandem is not allowed yet
Tap to open Shizuku and allow Tandem there
Update Shizuku to version 11 or newer
Your computer turns on the hotspot without a tap on this phone
Without Shizuku you tap a notification to turn it on
Sound and screen without questions or taps
Android no longer asks when this phone\'s sound or screen is shared, and a second screen or share started on the computer opens by itself. The notification that it is shared stays
Android asks each time the sound or the screen is shared, and a second screen opens only after a tap on its notification
Your computers offer to take it over when they have no network
Android lets only the shell read the password of a Wi-Fi network
Allow Location for Tandem too: without it Android hides the name of the Wi-Fi
